name: Release precompiled binaries

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - '*.*.*'          # Semantic version tags
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  create-release:
    name: Create draft release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      release_id: ${{ steps.release.outputs.id }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate tag against Cargo.toml
        run: |
          TAG=${{ github.ref_name }}
          VERSION=$(cargo metadata --format-version 1 | jq -r '.packages[0].version')
          if [[ "$TAG" != "$VERSION" ]]; then
            echo "Tag $TAG does not match Cargo.toml version $VERSION"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Create draft release
        id: release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: true
          prerelease: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  build-linux-x86_64-cpu:
    name: Linux x86_64 CPU
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: create-release
    env:
      RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""
      RELEASE_ID: ${{ needs.create-release.outputs.release_id }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install lld
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y lld

      - name: Build
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Package
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          cp target/release/cake dist/
          tar czf dist/cake-linux-x86_64-cpu.tar.gz -C dist cake
          shasum -a 256 dist/cake-linux-x86_64-cpu.tar.gz > dist/cake-linux-x86_64-cpu.tar.gz.sha256

      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: dist/cake-linux-x86_64-cpu.tar.gz
          asset_name: cake-linux-x86_64-cpu.tar.gz
          tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_id: ${{ env.RELEASE_ID }}
          draft: true
          overwrite: true

      - name: Upload checksum
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: dist/cake-linux-x86_64-cpu.tar.gz.sha256
          asset_name: cake-linux-x86_64-cpu.tar.gz.sha256
          tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_id: ${{ env.RELEASE_ID }}
